train_polybeast_agent: train a PolyBeast RL agent using the PyTorch Scalable Agent with configurable actors and learning steps
run_net_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the Net model to get action, policy logits, and baseline outputs
compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss using target policy logits, actions, and advantages
compute_entropy_loss: compute the entropy loss as the negative entropy of the policy from logits
compute_baseline_loss: compute the baseline loss as half the sum of squared advantages
